event_data.context: Signed 57c61d9 moves atomic checkpoint rename into the process holding the OS write fence. Tests cover an overlapping replacement, actual write-fence process death, and the built-in journal runner writing and resuming its checkpoint. Local full gate passed 95 tests. Both previous review threads are resolved and CI 45530426027 is running.
event_data.summary: Port and verify the testing tools, examples, and parity verification capabilities of EventCore 2.1.0 on Erlang/OTP.
